name: psychoclinic-backend
description: Backend API for Psychology Clinic Management SaaS

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(process.env.DATABASE_URL && (process.env.DATABASE_URL.startsWith('postgres') || process.env.DATABASE_URL.startsWith('postgresql'))) { fs.copyFileSync('prisma/schema.postgresql.prisma', 'prisma/schema.prisma'); }" && prisma generate && tsc
